articles.text_snippet: Leopold Aschenbrenner turned $225 million into a $45 billion fund in under two years by betting on everything AI would need. Then 4x leverage and a brutal July cost him $35 billion from the peak. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen breaks down the essay, the bets, the margin calls and Citadel's block trade, and whether he can run it back.
articles.title: He was right about AI and still lost $35 billion
